messages.subject: Sensitive HR matter - Director of Quality
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

We have received a formal grievance via solicitors from our Director of Quality, Dr Priya Saxena. It touches on a quality concern she raised on the Caldera programme last autumn and she is alleging she's been treated badly as a result. This needs careful handling and I'd like Whitfield Carter to advise the Board. Can you take this on? Happy to brief you by phone today.

Robert

Robert Falconer
Chief Executive
Halstead Aerospace Limited

messages.subject: RE: Sensitive HR matter - Director of Quality
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Robert,

Yes, we'd be glad to assist and I appreciate the sensitivity. I'm attaching our engagement letter (matter WC-00146). James Osei will have day-to-day conduct and I'll lead. A few immediate points: please preserve all documents and correspondence relating to Dr Saxena's disclosures, and please ensure the underlying quality concern is handled entirely separately from the employment question - the two must not be conflated.

I'll call you at 3pm.

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Employment
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
